items.title: Automating compliance testing with Fisent, Launchpad.io, and Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Learn how Kaufman Rossin partnered with Fisent Technologies, Launchpad.io by Pegasystems, and AWS to transform manual Regulation E compliance testing into a scalable Outcomes-as-a-Service solution. The service combines deterministic workflow automation, applied generative AI, and cloud-native AWS infrastructure. It has processed more than 100,000 dispute cases across 30+ fintechs. Along the way, Kaufman Rossin achieved 70% faster testing and 50% fewer manual hours.
items.creator: Ujwal Bukka
